title: Monica Contact Failure Rate
dataSources: Monica contacts (`monica:contact`), Clay relationships (`clay:relationship`), LinkedIn connections (`linkedin:connection`), follow-up reminders (`followup:reminder`), and intro requests (`intro:request`).
app: Monica contact relationship logs, Clay network exports, LinkedIn connection events, follow-up reminder tasks, and warm-intro request trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=monica:contact
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(contact_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by relationship_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Monica contact records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each relationship type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize contact_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per relationship type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your Monica contact data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
